'''Gallofree Yards, Inc.''' was a small manufacturer known for its [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]]. The company's vehicles were not as innovative or reliable as those made by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. Even with continued product overhauls and slick marketing, the company rarely turned a profit. Gallofree Yards eventually filed for bankruptcy several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], though many of its [[Starship/Legends|starships]] remained in active use as a part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]].
